sentences.en: He exhibited a number of behaviors typical of his diagnosis.

sentences.en: Do you google your symptoms to reach a diagnosis?
sentences.zh: 你会通过谷歌搜索症状来自行判断吗？

phrases.zh: 保守的诊断（意指不公开自己的病情）
